source_text_en: On-hand quantity × moving-average unit cost from the stock ledger, now, per Item Type (or per warehouse). Each balance has an explicit valuation status, never inferred from the cost: only "verified" value is shown as the headline figure. Recorded cost whose source is not verified ("valuation status unverified") and balances that mix sources are shown apart and are NOT part of the verified value. Used tire stock, stock marked "not valued" and stock at no recorded unit cost carry no value (quantities per unit of measure only, never read as 0); verified zero is counted separately. The recorded total is a partial figure, not the whole inventory value, whenever anything is unverified.

Setiap saldo memiliki status valuasi eksplisit, tidak disimpulkan dari angka biaya: hanya nilai "terverifikasi" yang menjadi angka utama. Biaya tercatat yang sumbernya belum diverifikasi ("status valuasi belum terverifikasi") dan saldo bersumber campuran ditampilkan terpisah dan TIDAK termasuk nilai terverifikasi. Stok ban bekas, stok bertanda "belum dinilai", dan stok tanpa biaya satuan tercatat tidak membawa nilai (hanya kuantitas per satuan, tidak dibaca sebagai 0); nilai nol terverifikasi dihitung terpisah. source_text_en: Vehicles ranked by operating cost in the period: parts and tires actually consumed (issue-time unit cost, on the consumption date) + mechanic cost (work hours from start to QC, excluding holds and waiting for QC, × the mechanic's hourly rate at assignment, in the month the work interval ends; running work counts up to now) + external cost actually paid (External Work Order settlements and Service Invoice payments, on the payment date). Not the same basis as Service Cost, which uses document values. Mechanic cost needs recorded work time: a Work Order started before work times were recorded shows the mechanic cost as unavailable (never 0), and its vehicle total is marked "recorded costs only".
translated_text_id: Kendaraan diurutkan menurut biaya operasional pada periode: sparepart dan ban yang benar-benar terpakai (biaya satuan saat issue, pada tanggal konsumsi) + biaya mekanik (jam kerja dari mulai hingga QC, tanpa jeda dan tanpa menunggu QC, × tarif per jam mekanik saat ditugaskan, pada bulan interval kerja berakhir; pekerjaan berjalan dihitung sampai sekarang) + biaya eksternal yang benar-benar dibayar (pelunasan WO eksternal dan pembayaran Service Invoice, pada tanggal bayar). Basisnya berbeda dari Biaya Servis yang memakai nilai dokumen. Biaya mekanik membutuhkan waktu kerja tercatat: WO yang dimulai sebelum waktu kerja dicatat menampilkan biaya mekanik sebagai tidak tersedia (bukan 0), dan total kendaraannya ditandai "hanya biaya tercatat".

source_text_en: For one maintenance type: Work Orders completed in the period × each mechanic's average work hours per completed Work Order (only Work Orders whose work time was recorded from the start). Work hours = start to QC, plus rework, excluding holds, waiting for parts and QC. The status needs a baseline and at least the minimum number of samples; an average equal to the baseline meets it. Completed Work Orders without complete work-time history are excluded and counted; with no valid sample the average is unavailable, never 0.

Jam kerja = mulai hingga QC, ditambah rework, tanpa jeda, menunggu part, dan QC. Status membutuhkan baseline dan jumlah sampel minimum; rata-rata yang sama dengan baseline dianggap memenuhi. WO selesai tanpa riwayat waktu kerja lengkap dikecualikan dan dihitung jumlahnya; tanpa sampel valid rata-rata tidak tersedia, bukan 0.

source_text_en: Vehicles linked to a telematics device (OptiRadar). A device that reports a real odometer updates the vehicle directly. GPS distance is only kept as a reading until the link is calibrated against the odometer recorded here; after that it can only raise the odometer, never lower it.
translated_text_id: Kendaraan yang ditautkan ke perangkat telematika (OptiRadar). Perangkat yang melaporkan odometer asli memperbarui kendaraan secara langsung. Jarak GPS hanya disimpan sebagai pembacaan sampai tautan dikalibrasi terhadap odometer yang tercatat di sini; setelah itu hanya dapat menaikkan odometer, tidak pernah menurunkannya.

context: Table header (what happened to the latest reading)

translated_text_id: Tidak lebih tinggi dari saat ini
context: Badge (reading did not raise the odometer)

source_text_en: No vehicles are linked to a telematics device yet.
translated_text_id: Belum ada kendaraan yang ditautkan ke perangkat telematika.

source_text_en: Choose how GPS distance maps to this vehicle's odometer. Readings from now on are shifted by the offset and can only raise the odometer.
translated_text_id: Pilih bagaimana jarak GPS dipetakan ke odometer kendaraan ini. Pembacaan berikutnya digeser sebesar selisih dan hanya dapat menaikkan odometer.

source_text_en: The real odometer at the time of the latest GPS reading. The offset is this value minus that reading.
translated_text_id: Odometer sebenarnya pada saat pembacaan GPS terakhir. Selisih adalah nilai ini dikurangi pembacaan tersebut.

source_text_en: Kilometres added to the GPS distance to get the odometer. May be negative.
translated_text_id: Kilometer yang ditambahkan ke jarak GPS untuk mendapatkan odometer. Boleh negatif.
